description: NaPr₂S₂O₈F₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four O and three F atoms. There are two shorter (2.48 Å) and two longer (2.62 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There is one shorter (2.34 Å) and two longer (2.59 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Pr is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to six O and four F atoms. There are a spread of Pr-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.72 Å. There are a spread of Pr-F bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.57 Å. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.50 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Pr and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Pr and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Pr, and one S atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to one Na and three equivalent Pr atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing FNaPr₃ tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Pr atoms.
